name: Adaptive Projection
definition: An algorithm for generating line integrals (sums or weighted averages) along a sight-line in adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) data, returning a list of finest-resolution data points rather than a fixed-resolution array, to save storage and allow instant image construction.
summary: Adaptive Projection generates sparse lists of finest-resolution data points for AMR volume rendering, reducing storage and computation by excluding superseded coarser data.
